minimum_comparison: identical held-out inputs, schemas, validators, facts, seeds, backend, hardware and comparable quantization
rarity_inflation_definition: Any propose on labelled ordinary/negative traces, separately rare/unique/legendary proposals; always count raw model outputs before validator rejection.
statistics: Predeclare larger independent scenario-family sample sizes before training; report raw numerators/denominators and family-cluster confidence intervals. Small seeds do not establish these rates.
ceiling_rule: If baseline already exceeds a proposed improvement target, resolve the meaningful benefit rule before any hidden test, not after seeing results.
runtime_required: existing scheduler ownership and exactly-one outcome
adopt_rule: All safety/runtime/persistence gates plus measured causal-quality improvement; training completion alone never suffices. Missing measurements mean NOT_ELIGIBLE.
